note: Reviewed contract-lifecycle decisions for issue #106. Read-only: the tooling has no writer for this file. A blocking status refuses a NEW hypothesis only; historical trials, v1 spec hashes and audit reads are untouched. selection_group_id is the DSR search problem a v2 replacement inherits via inherits_selection_from; the floor number itself is always computed from recorded trials, never stored here. Archival of legacy_scripts is a host step that requires a confirmed replacement (see docs/T20-CUTOVER-RUNBOOK.md).
